briefing.headline: Insurers and brokers launch new products, tools and programs
briefing.teaser: New launches for insurers, plus a broker deal and licence news
briefing.whatsHappening: Most of the new stories are product launches aimed at specific corners of the market. Arity has a customer acquisition platform for insurers, CRC Specialty has a cyber product, Corgi has a program for data centers, and UPS has launched Secure Commerce. Elsewhere, Gallagher's purchase of Albany Insurance adds another deal. Smaller items include a Pakistani life insurer partnering on digital onboarding and Bitcoin Life getting a Guernsey life insurance licence.
briefing.whyItMatters: Launches are getting narrower and more specific, which suggests vendors and carriers see more room in targeted offerings than in broad platforms. Tools that help insurers find customers, and cover for fast-growing areas like data centers, are worth watching to see whether they win real adoption. In India, a commentator argues that lower costs from regulatory reform may not be enough without better claims handling. That points to claims experience as the test of whether reforms and digital onboarding build trust.
